name: Neptune
tagline: The windiest world — an ice giant found by mathematics before telescopes.
history: Neptune is the only planet found by calculation: astronomers Adams and Le Verrier independently deduced its position from wobbles in Uranus's orbit, and Johann Galle found it within one degree of the prediction in 1846 — a triumph of Newtonian physics. Voyager 2's 1989 flyby is still humanity's only visit; it revealed supersonic winds up to 2,100 km/h — the fastest in the Solar System — and great dark storms that come and go. Its largest moon Triton orbits backwards, evidence it is a captured Kuiper Belt object, and it vents nitrogen geysers from a frozen surface at −235 °C.
